# Issue Template

When creating issues, always use this format for the Issue body:

## Overview

Provide the summary issue overview
EXAMPLE: feature authentication plus onboarding users

## What & why

Provide the explanation about what, and why this change must do. Plus if there is trade-off because this feature or change then elaborate here.

## Documented Business Flow or Planning

Provide the documented flow before and after the change if necessary, and please provide with flowchart diagram using mermaid.js format

## UI Reference

Provide the UI design for this issue so anyone now the context and how the features works

## Acceptance criteria

Provide the acceptance criteria for the features or issues

---
